composition_subtypes.role: Sort group explosion times ascending for binary search over answer X.
Greedily pop X+1 largest explosion times to simulate manual triggers.

payload.composition_order: First sort times, then binary search with greedy check.
payload.core_composition_summary: Groups mines via DSU, sorts group min explosion times, then binary searches answer with greedy selection of manual detonations.
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly combines sorting (ordering group times) with binary search and a greedy popping strategy, leveraging multiple coordinated mechanisms beyond a single algorithm.
